item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 29 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 29 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 10 September 2026(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan(Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Orani, Morong, Samal).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Cavite, Batangas and Laguna within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac(Moncada, Paniqui, Gerona, Santa Ignacia, Camiling, Mayantoc, San Clemente, Anao, San Manuel, San Jose, Pura, Ramos, Victoria, Bamban), Nueva Ecija(Pantabangan, San Jose, Lupao, Carranglan, Santa Rosa, Cabanatuan, Palayan, Penaranda, San Leonardo, Jaen, San Antonio, Gapan, San Isidro, Cabiao), Bulacan(San Miguel, Norzagaray, Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Bulakan, Balagtas, Malolos, San Rafael, Angat, Pandi, Bustos, Plaridel, Santa Maria, Bocaue, Marilao, Meycauayan, Obando), Rizal(Binangonan, Taytay, Angono, Cardona, Morong, Rodriguez), Quezon(General Nakar, Panukulan, Burdeos, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Buenavista, Lopez, Catanauan, General Luna, Calauag, Jomalig, Patnanungan, Polillo), Metro Manila(Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas), Pampanga(Candaba, Porac) and Bataan(Pilar, Orion, Balanga, Bagac, Abucay) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
